options_for_selector.definition: Keep binding-literal-all-registry-v1 exactly as implemented (vendor/gems57/uniqueness.py binding_duplicate_decision_v3 literal wrapper, IR-88-86).
options_for_selector.consequence: Zero candidates can ever be generated or promoted from this fleet. All research stays download-only. This is the current state and needs no action.

options_for_selector.definition: For registry rasters whose 3-px halo covers the whole allowed domain (halo_coverage = 1.0, i.e. non-discriminating for the dot test), replace only the dot-overlap reading with the already-implemented shared equal-support definition (vendor/gems57/uniqueness.py: registry_dots / equal_support_overlap; top-K allowed cells at the candidate's dot budget, deterministic row-major ties) and/or the chance-corrected excess_overlap diagnostic, while KEEPING (a) surface Spearman |rho| <= 0.90 against every raster including dense ones, (b) literal 3-px overlap <= 0.70 against every discriminating (sparse/dot) raster, (c) all holdout/canary/format gates unchanged.
options_for_selector.consequence: Candidates become testable again. A candidate thresholded from the dense surface itself still fails (its dots coincide with the surface's top-K). Blanketing sparse lattices (e.g. spacing-5 calibration lattice reported by GEMSDOE24/31/32) must be classified by the same halo_coverage test, not by file type.
options_for_selector.risk: Weaker than literal against dense priors by design; mitigated by retaining the Spearman surface test on every raster and by re-screening the final candidate against the complete current fleet registry (including all concurrent lanes) at promotion time.

options_for_selector.definition: Restrict the duplicate screen to a short peer list (the approach GEMSDOE27 records for its H31 promotion: 12 pinned peers + own-repo rasters, 27 total).
options_for_selector.consequence: Promotion becomes easy but incomparable across the fleet and blind to known blanketing/duplicate rasters outside the short list.
options_for_selector.risk: Highest false-uniqueness risk. GEMSDOE88 does not recommend C. It is included only because one focus site has already adopted it unilaterally (IR-88-0B582CF7-01).

recommendation: B, recorded prospectively (never retroactively to an already-built file), with the safeguards below. Recommendation is not adoption.
safeguards_required_under_option_b: Preregister the exact registry inventory (file list + SHA-256 of the concatenated sorted list) before the candidate is screened; post-merge concurrent lanes must be added and the screen re-run before any slot decision.
Report literal, equal-support/excess and Spearman readings side by side for every registry raster (no silent dropping).

Keep the leakage canary (single-feature symmetric AUC <= 0.90), buffered whole-segment hide-and-recover holdout (gems57-pooled-hide-v2) with strictly-positive paired 95% CI vs the same-fold incumbent, and strict full-grid [0,1] format validation as independent gates.
Require an authenticated quota/receipt check on the DrivenData submission page at slot time; this sandbox cannot verify quota.
One candidate per lane; no threshold/budget search on the holdout after seeing results (max 3 experiments / 2 hours per Protocol rule 6 budget).
